sentences.en: For relaxation, Copernicus painted and translated Greek poetry into Latin.
sentences.zh: 哥白尼为了放松自己，画了画并把希腊诗歌翻译成了拉丁文。

sentences.en: I want you to have more relaxation in your life.
sentences.zh: 我希望你生活中有更多的休闲时光。

sentences.en: There is no aspect of relaxation more important than breathing.
sentences.zh: 没有哪一种放松比呼吸更重要。

senses.zh: 松弛，放松；缓和，减轻；休息，消遣，娱乐
